messages:
Amaia: heads-up — onboarding long-context model on dedicated. quick check: weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/longctx-30k/v1/, tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/onboard/longctx-30k/v1/tokenizer.json. can infra/serving confirm kv cache format and max_context we should use?

Sam: thanks, noted. I pulled the weights. config in repo currently has:
```
model: longctx-30k
max_context: 32768
kv_cache_format: v1
batch_size: 1
```
I think kv_cache_format=v1 is the older packed format. infra prefers v2 (sliced) for >16k.

Jonathan: quick tech note — the tokenizer increments BOS token id in a weird way (off-by-1 for some prefixes). that caused kv indexing misalignments in a previous onboarding. make sure tokenization tests pass with sample texts before enabling kv cache.

Infra-bot: deploy-check — model config validation: FAILED
- max_context (32768) > serving.max_kv_len (16384)
- kv_cache_format 'v1' deprecated for context > 16384
See /infra/serving/validation_errors/1751286420.log

Leah: from infra sizing: on A100-80GB, rough memory footprint for kv cache with this model (~7B-ish hidden size) is ~1.8GB per 1024 tokens per batch. so 32k single-stream ~56GB for kv alone if batch_size>1 you OOM. rule of thumb: keep batch_size=1 or use kv slicing.

Mike: suggestion — set kv_cache_format: v2 (sliced) and max_context: 24576 for initial rollout. that keeps headroom and avoids falling back. also we should add a runtime guard that rejects requests > serving.max_kv_len with clear 413-like error.

Amaia: good. action items: Sam update model config to v2 + max_context=24576, add tokenizer sanity tests to CI, and Leah/infra run memory-profile job on infra staging. anyone object?

Sam: I'll open a PR now. will also add a small script to validate token alignment: `scripts/check_token_alignment.py sample_prompts.json` and add to pre-onboard checklist.

Jonathan: for the tokenizer quirk I recommend adding a deterministic test: take 50 random prompts, tokenise with our tokenizer and with HF tokenizer, assert lengths and first token ids agree or we log diff. small diff is fine but must be accounted for in kv offsets.

CI-bot: PR #8427 created by Sam: "onboard/longctx-30k: kv_format=v2, max_context=24576, add tokenizer tests" — CI started.

Infra-bot: scheduled mem-profile job: infra/staging/longctx-30k-profile @ 2025-10-01T22:00Z. results link: https://ci.redwood/infra-profiles/longctx-30k/1751286420

Leah: one more: when you flip kv_cache_format to v2, double-check compatibility with checkpoints converted with the old packer. we had a migration tool `tools/kv_migrate.py --from v1 --to v2` — run on a copy.

Mike: pinging eng-sre to add a temporary autosquelch on alerts for OOM on nodes running this model during the first 24h of rollout.

Amaia: perfect. will monitor. thanks everyone — let's reconvene async after the profile runs. :thumbsup:
